options.content:
**Live**: who is logging the most right now, and how it compares with the same time yesterday. **Capacity**: whether Vector and the logging Elasticsearch keep up (filtered on cluster only). **History**: namespaces above the agreed volume over 3 hours and 7 days.
Platform namespaces have no client or environment kind: keep those filters on All to see them.

panels.description: All namespaces of the cluster, as counted by Vector.
panels.title: Log lines/s per cluster

panels.description: All namespaces of the cluster, message bytes as counted by Vector.
panels.title: Log bytes/s per cluster

panels.description: The ten namespaces with the most lines at each point in time.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
sum by (cluster, namespace) (
  label_replace(
    sum by (cluster, exported_namespace) (rate(vector_log_counter{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))
  , "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", label_client=~"$client", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)
)

panels.title: Top 10 namespaces, lines/s

panels.description: The ten namespaces with the most bytes at each point in time.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
sum by (cluster, namespace) (
  label_replace(
    sum by (cluster, exported_namespace) (rate(vector_message_len_bytes_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))
  , "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", label_client=~"$client", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)
)

panels.title: Top 10 namespaces, bytes/s

panels.description: Namespaces logging more than 10 lines/s over the last 5 minutes of the time range, against the same 5 minutes one day earlier. A high ratio names a namespace that started flooding.

targets.expr:
sum by (cluster, namespace) (
  label_replace(
    sum by (cluster, exported_namespace) (rate(vector_log_counter{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]))
  , "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", label_client=~"$client", namespace=~"$namespace"})
) > 10

sum by (cluster, namespace) (
  label_replace(
    sum by (cluster, exported_namespace) (rate(vector_log_counter{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m] offset 1d))
  , "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", label_client=~"$client", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)

sum by (cluster, namespace) (
  label_replace(
    sum by (cluster, exported_namespace) (rate(vector_message_len_bytes_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]))
  , "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{cluster=~"$cluster", label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", label_client=~"$client", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)

panels.title: Namespaces now vs same time yesterday

panels.description: Fullest Vector disk buffer of the cluster. At 100 % Vector drops or blocks new logs.
panels.title: Vector disk buffer fill (max over pods)

panels.description: Number of Vector pods whose fullest disk buffer is above 90 %.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, pod) (vector_buffer_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster"} / vector_buffer_max_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster"}) > bool 0.9)

panels.title: Vector pods with a buffer above 90 %

panels.description: Events written into the disk buffers against events sent to the sinks. In above out means the buffers are growing.
panels.title: Vector disk buffer in vs out

panels.description: Age of container log lines when Vector reads them (kubernetes_logs source). It climbs when Vector cannot keep up with what pods write.
panels.title: Vector read lag p99

panels.description: Fullest data node of each tier. Dashed lines: 90 % (ESDiskLowWatermark alert) and 95 % (high watermark).
panels.title: Elasticsearch logging disk usage per tier (max over nodes)

panels.description: Documents indexed per second by the logging cluster. Per-node counters drop when shards move away, so each node's slope is floored at zero instead of read as a counter reset.
panels.title: Elasticsearch logging indexing rate
Logging amount, per 3 hours: absolute limit reached
Logging amount, per day, per cpu, 7-days average

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  sum by (exported_namespace) (
      increase(vector_message_len_bytes_sum{cluster=~"$cluster"}[1d])
  )
  / on (exported_namespace) (
    sum by (exported_namespace) (
      increase(vector_log_counter{cluster=~"$cluster"}[1d])
    ) > 100000
  )
, "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")
> 0
